speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You came down the stair like a man who means to leave the house. August came down like a man asking the wall for leave.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The back is eased. I am not going to make a feast of it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I heard it from the copper, sir. The third tread didn't complain. Gib was on it, and you stepped over him.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The third tread is his. You have been putting a foot on him since August, and blaming the back. Today you looked.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I looked because I could. The tooth is the same tooth. Do not promote the back over it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I am not promoting anything. Sit. The loaf is the loaf you left. I am carrying the jug, and I am asking while I have it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ask.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. You are going out at two. If you eat a dinner you will be sorry on a stage, and if you eat nothing I shall be sorry at this board. Which sorry am I to have?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three bites. The rest keeps till I am home. I play at two.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Three bites is what the tooth will allow, sir, whatever the stage says. The left side still won't have the crust.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then the crust stays. I am not cutting a second loaf to flatter a tooth, and I am not sending a player out faint. Three bites, and the clove you bought, and you may go.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The clove is already in the cheek. It is doing what a clove does, which is not much, and enough.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Your jaw's quieter than Sunday. It isn't quiet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is not quiet. It is going with me. That is the arrangement.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And the play. I will have the name of it before you take the stair the other way. I let you the room. I did not undertake to guess the bill.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Knave. At the Theatre. Two of the clock. The plot gives me no name of a side, and I am not inventing one at your table.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is there a boy in it, sir? Is there a girl?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is a plot on a peg. There is not a story I am going to tell before I have stood in it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then I shall have no verdict, and you shall not have the satisfaction of hearing one. Bring the side home unnamed. Wash before you sit to supper.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I'll keep the rest of the loaf under the cloth. Three bites is a poor dinner for a man who walked the lane last night.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The lane was for the back, and the back has answered. I am not going out to walk it again.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Good. The close has had enough of you pacing it for one Sunday. Today you work, and you come back, and you do not feed this kitchen on what you will not say.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is nothing unsaid that belongs to this kitchen. I go as billed. No order has come to stop it, and none has come to change it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then go as billed. I do not know your orders, and I am not asking to be taught them between the jug and the door.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Shall I put the water on the landing, sir, for when you come in?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: On the landing. Not up. I will not have you waiting on a speech that is not being written.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Hear him, Alse. The copper is your business till the wash is done. His business is two of the clock, and mine is the three bites he is about to pretend are a meal.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not pretending. Three bites, the soft of it, and I am gone.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The cloth will be over the rest, sir, so supper knows where to find it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Leave Gib where he is. Clear the board when this man has gone, and do not count his mouth for him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave Gib. He earned the tread by not being under the foot. God keep this house till supper.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: God keep you as far as Shoreditch, and send you back in a state to chew. I am not promising the crust will have grown kinder.
